name: AutomationDirect DK20 enclosure drip shield
aliases: AutomationDirect DK20 enclosure drip shield GA
summary: DK20 enclosure drip shield arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: DK20 is the drawing identifier for enclosure drip shield in AutomationDirect's Enclosure Accessories collection. A drip shield forms part of the selected enclosure installation arrangement. Its mounting and overhang must be coordinated with the enclosure and the required service access.

For example, in an enclosure installation with a separately selected top shield, use the DK20 reference to coordinate shield fixing, overhang and access to adjacent equipment. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/DK20.dwg, Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/SSDK20.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep shield fixing, overhang and access to adjacent equipment visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named DK20 drawing and its enclosure drip shield role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
